_comment: Species codes (KEGG) whose organism has an Ensembl / Ensembl Genomes genebuild, and where its
cross-reference TSV dumps live. Consulted by scripts/default/{download_others,build_database}.py for
every species that has no <code>_resources/ directory of its own, and checked by
species-path is relative to <division>/tsv/ (Ensembl Genomes files many fungi under *_collection/).
xrefs lists which of the entrez and uniprot dumps the genebuild publishes; a species with only a uniprot
dump is linked to KEGG through the UniProt accessions KEGG itself maps (processEnsemblUniProtData).
